entities.name: Chunth
entities.description: Elder troll of Mirrodin, The First One, leader of the trolls who recorded history on the Tree of Tales; hated the metallic world.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Warrior of the Tangle, the likely target of the leveler attack, kidnapped by the trolls.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Being who brought Chunth to Mirrodin and who will be Glissa's greatest obstacle.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Metallic plane that Chunth detested; revealed to be hollow.

entities.name: Tree of Tales
entities.description: Tree within the Tangle where trolls record history.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Faction that produced the serum from blinkmoths.

entities.name: Levelers
entities.description: Attackers who kill everyone at their targets' homes.

events.summary: Chunth, a troll brought to Mirrodin by Memnarch, meets Glissa.
events.quote: Chunth hailed from another, unnamed world and was brought to Mirrodin by Memnarch .

events.summary: Chunth tells Glissa about the levelers and that her flares show ancestral memories from another world.
events.quote: Chunth also revealed that her flares showed her ancestral memories from another world

events.summary: A renegade troll attacks Glissa; Chunth saves her but is mortally wounded, and the renegade steals her serum.
events.quote: Chunth managed to save Glissa but was mortally wounded in the process.

relations.note: He led the trolls who recorded history there.
relations.quote: He was the leader of the trolls who recorded the history on the Tree of Tales within the Tangle .
was brought to Mirrodin by Memnarch .
